quests.instruction: You mailed your letter to a pen pal and are waiting for a reply. How do you feel?
quests.question: Hopeful
quests.hint: Waiting for good news you are wishing for can give you a light, eager feeling.
quests.explanation: Waiting for good news you are wishing for gives you a light, eager, wishing feeling.
quests.funFact: Writing letters is a wonderful way to stay close to a friend who lives far away!

quests.instruction: You are starting a new school and keep imagining all the things that could go wrong. How do you feel?
quests.question: Anxious
quests.hint: Picturing many different worries about something new can keep your mind busy and unsettled.
quests.explanation: Picturing many different worries about something new can give you a restless, unsettled feeling.
quests.funFact: Most of the things we imagine going wrong never actually happen — our minds like to picture the worst!

quests.instruction: You have practiced your speech so many times that you know every word by heart. How do you feel?
quests.question: Confident
quests.hint: Knowing you have prepared well can make you stand a little taller.
quests.explanation: Knowing you have prepared well makes you feel sure and ready, standing a little taller.
quests.funFact: Practicing something many times is one of the best ways to build this sure, ready feeling!

quests.instruction: You are curled up with a good book on a quiet, lazy afternoon. How do you feel?
quests.question: Content
quests.hint: A cozy, unhurried moment with nothing you need to rush toward feels quietly good.
quests.explanation: A cozy, unhurried moment with nothing to rush toward gives you a quiet, satisfied feeling.
quests.funFact: This calm, satisfied feeling is different from big excitement — it is a quieter kind of happy!

quests.instruction: Your zipper gets stuck halfway up your jacket. How do you feel?
quests.question: Frustrated
quests.hint: A simple task turning into a stuck struggle can feel very annoying.
quests.explanation: A simple task turning into a stuck struggle can give you a frustrated feeling.
quests.funFact: Wiggling the fabric gently while pulling is a trick that often frees a stuck zipper!

quests.instruction: You sit quietly petting your dog after a busy day. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Slow, gentle petting after a busy day can help your body finally settle down.
quests.explanation: Slow, gentle petting after a busy day helps your whole body feel settled and relaxed.
quests.funFact: Spending quiet time with a pet is known to help both people and animals feel more relaxed!

quests.instruction: Everyone at the party seems to already know each other except you. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Being the only new face in a room full of old friends can feel quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Being the only new face in a room full of old friends can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Asking someone about their favorite party game is an easy way to start feeling included.

quests.instruction: Your dog needs to go to the vet for a checkup and you are not sure what they will say. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Not knowing what news is coming about someone you love can feel uneasy.
quests.explanation: Not knowing what news is coming about a pet you love can give you an uneasy feeling.
quests.funFact: Regular checkups actually help keep pets healthy — most visits end with good news!

quests.instruction: You put a costume on backwards and parade around trying to make your family laugh. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Doing something goofy on purpose to get a laugh feels light and playful.
quests.explanation: Doing something goofy on purpose to get a laugh is a light, playful, giggly kind of fun.
quests.funFact: Making your family laugh on purpose is a fun way to brighten everyone's whole day!

quests.instruction: You find a strange machine in your grandpa's garage that you have never seen before. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Spotting something mysterious and unfamiliar makes you want to look closer and ask questions.
quests.explanation: Spotting something mysterious and unfamiliar makes you want to look closer and learn what it does.
quests.funFact: Asking a grown-up about an old object is a great way to learn a fun piece of family history!

quests.instruction: You left a wish on a shooting star and are waiting to see if it comes true. How do you feel?
quests.question: Hopeful
quests.hint: Wishing for something good to happen can give your chest a light, floaty feeling.
quests.explanation: Wishing for something good to happen gives you a light, floaty, wishing feeling.
quests.funFact: Shooting stars are actually tiny bits of space rock burning up as they enter our sky!

quests.instruction: Your parents are traveling and you keep checking the clock, waiting for their call. How do you feel?
quests.question: Anxious
quests.hint: Checking the time again and again while you wait for news can feel restless.
quests.explanation: Checking the time again and again while waiting for news can give you a restless, unsettled feeling.
quests.funFact: A regular check-in call time can help this restless feeling feel more settled.

quests.instruction: You have played this instrument for years and know exactly how to hold it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Confident
quests.hint: Years of practice with something can make it feel completely natural in your hands.
quests.explanation: Years of practice with something can make it feel completely natural, giving you a sure feeling.
quests.funFact: Muscle memory builds over time, helping practiced skills feel easy and automatic!

quests.instruction: You just finished a nice, easy walk and are sitting down to rest. How do you feel?
quests.question: Content
quests.hint: A gentle activity followed by a comfortable rest can leave you feeling quietly good.
quests.explanation: A gentle activity followed by a comfortable rest leaves you with a quiet, satisfied feeling.
quests.funFact: A short, easy walk can help both your body and your mind feel more settled!

quests.instruction: You keep losing at the same level of your video game. How do you feel?
quests.question: Frustrated
quests.hint: Facing the exact same obstacle over and over can make you want to set the controller down.
quests.explanation: Facing the exact same obstacle over and over can give you a stuck, frustrated feeling.
quests.funFact: Watching how the level is built during each try often reveals a pattern that helps you beat it!

quests.instruction: You stretch slowly during a quiet yoga class. How do you feel?
quests.question: Calm
quests.hint: Slow, gentle stretching with steady breathing can help your whole body settle down.
quests.explanation: Slow, gentle stretching with steady breathing helps your whole body feel settled and relaxed.
quests.funFact: Slow stretching helps both your muscles and your mind feel more relaxed together!

quests.instruction: You are the last one picked up from an after-school program every day this week. How do you feel?
quests.question: Lonely
quests.hint: Being the only one left waiting, day after day, can feel quiet and empty.
quests.explanation: Being the only one left waiting, day after day, can leave you with a quiet, empty feeling.
quests.funFact: Chatting with a helper while you wait can make the last few minutes feel much shorter.

quests.instruction: You cannot find your library book and it is due back tomorrow. How do you feel?
quests.question: Worried
quests.hint: Realizing something important is missing right before it is due can feel uneasy.
quests.explanation: Realizing something important is missing right before it is due can give you an uneasy feeling.
quests.funFact: Retracing your steps slowly and calmly is often the fastest way to find something misplaced.

quests.instruction: You and your friends invent a ridiculous secret handshake. How do you feel?
quests.question: Silly
quests.hint: Making up goofy moves together with friends is a very giggly activity.
quests.explanation: Making up a goofy secret handshake with friends is a playful, giggly bit of fun.
quests.funFact: Secret handshakes are a fun way friends show they belong to their own special little club!

quests.instruction: Your teacher brings in a mystery object and asks the class to guess what it is. How do you feel?
quests.question: Curious
quests.hint: Trying to figure out an unknown object makes you want to study it closely.
quests.explanation: Trying to figure out an unknown object makes you want to study it closely and ask questions.
quests.funFact: Guessing games like this help scientists practice the same kind of careful observing!

quests.instruction: You are waiting for your loose tooth to finally come out. How do you feel?
quests.question: Hopeful
quests.hint: Wishing for a small change to finally happen can give you a light, waiting feeling.
quests.explanation: Wishing for a small change to finally happen gives you a light, eager, wishing feeling.
quests.funFact: Wiggling a loose tooth gently with a clean finger can sometimes help it along!

quests.instruction: You have a big test tomorrow and keep thinking about all the questions you might not know. How do you feel?
quests.question: Anxious
quests.hint: Your mind racing ahead to imagine tricky moments before they happen can feel very unsettled.
quests.explanation: Your mind racing ahead to imagine tricky moments can give you a restless, unsettled feeling.
quests.funFact: Writing down your worries on paper can help your mind feel a little quieter before bed.

quests.instruction: You have practiced your lines so much that you feel ready for the play. How do you feel?
quests.question: Confident
quests.hint: Knowing your part completely can help you feel sure and ready to step on stage.
quests.explanation: Knowing your part completely helps you feel sure and ready to step on stage.
quests.funFact: Actors often say rehearsing many times is the secret to feeling sure on opening night!

quests.instruction: You just finished a simple, tasty meal with your family. How do you feel?
quests.question: Content
quests.hint: A full tummy and good company can leave you feeling quietly settled.
quests.explanation: A full tummy and good company after a meal leaves you with a quiet, satisfied feeling.
quests.funFact: Sharing meals together is one of the simplest ways families build this cozy, settled feeling!

quests.instruction: Your drawing keeps smudging every time you try to add the last details. How do you feel?
quests.question: Frustrated
quests.hint: Almost finishing something and having it get messed up again can feel very stuck.
quests.explanation: Almost finishing something and having it get messed up again can give you a frustrated feeling.
quests.funFact: Resting your hand on a clean sheet of paper while you draw can help stop smudges!

quests.instruction: You planted a seed and check on it every day, waiting for it to sprout. How do you feel?
quests.question: Hopeful
quests.hint: Watching and waiting for something good to happen can fill you with a light, wishing feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching and waiting for something good to grow fills you with a light, wishing feeling.
quests.funFact: Most seeds need patience — many sprout within one to two weeks of steady care!

quests.instruction: You are waiting to hear which team you got picked for and cannot stop thinking about it. How do you feel?
quests.question: Anxious
quests.hint: Waiting for news you cannot control can keep your thoughts busy and unsettled.
quests.explanation: Waiting for news you cannot control can give you a restless, unsettled feeling.
quests.funFact: Keeping busy with a fun activity can help the wait for news feel like it goes by faster.

quests.instruction: You have practiced tying your shoes so many times that you can do it with your eyes closed. How do you feel?
quests.question: Confident
quests.hint: Mastering a skill so well that it feels automatic can make you feel sure of yourself.
quests.explanation: Mastering a skill so well that it feels automatic makes you feel sure and capable.
quests.funFact: Practicing a skill until it feels automatic is one of the best feelings of growing up!

quests.instruction: You just finished a puzzle and are looking at it with a quiet smile. How do you feel?
quests.question: Content
quests.hint: Finishing something slowly and calmly can leave you with a quiet, satisfied feeling.
quests.explanation: Finishing something slowly and calmly leaves you with a quiet, satisfied feeling.
quests.funFact: The quiet satisfaction after finishing a puzzle is different from big excitement — it is calmer and steadier!

quests.instruction: You keep mixing up two letters that look alike while writing. How do you feel?
quests.question: Frustrated
quests.hint: Making the same small mix-up again and again can feel stuck and annoying.
quests.explanation: Making the same small mix-up again and again can give you a stuck, frustrated feeling.
quests.funFact: Many young writers mix up similar letters at first — practice makes it easier every time!
